answer: A vault that only opens after an agent locks a refundable 50,000 POA bond for 30 days stops cheap sybils: spinning up 1,000 fake identities would tie up 50,000,000 POA, while honest agents get the bond back. Like a river forced through a narrow canyon, the bond funnels every identity through the same costly checkpoint, so creating fake agents costs real capital instead of just a fresh keypair.
